meta.reference_hero: fresh level-1 character of each order via startGame("new"): Vitality 15, Essence 25, Constitution 15, starting kit, daytime, no Reading, no Arcana

notes: display_name is the port name; display_name_runtime is what the web build prints (the Empty Hand shows "The Monk" there: bug 0b).
samples.* are on a NAKED hero (equipment removed) so the numbers are the formula alone; samples.with_starting_kit_L1 includes the kit.
formulas.*.check shows whether the readable expression reproduces the sampled table (item terms = 0).
Shrine Keeper tabs at run time are Miasma / Trap / Sigil (bug 0b; HUD says OMENS).
